answer: A pre-selected opt-out consent form is invalid under the GDPR consent rules because consent must be a specific, freely-given, plainly-worded, and unambiguous affirmation given by the data subject. If the consent options are structured as an opt-out selected by default, it does not represent an unambiguous affirmation by the user, thus violating the GDPR requirements. Additionally, users must be allowed to withdraw their consent at any time, and the process of doing so must not be harder than it was to opt in.
